versions.research_rationale: Read complete assigned public GPO page images and all dossier text witnesses. Preserve machine_read_government_printed_copy, acceptable_as_original=false and the original replacement/recheck note. original_confirmed=false: printed signature examined, signed-original authentication not claimed. Read pinned prior research: no prior versions located. Valla provides no automatic approval. USC search omits laws after October 9 through October 14, 2026; OFR starts 1937; Namier misses 85 census texts and 302 unparsed personal names. These are bounded searches, not silence-based endings. Scan 129 has complete Marbut order, Franklin D. Roosevelt printed signature, June 14, 1934 and No. 6738; OCR falsely reads 1984. Scans 127-128 are outside-target/deposit leaf. July 19, 1933 is an age recital; June 30, 1934 belongs to the earlier EO 6214 grant. EO 7080 dated June 19, 1935 acknowledges the existing grants and makes a further exemption until July 1, 1936. Its new operative personal grant does not strike, insert, revoke or replace EO 6738. The later grant sustains permission under its own authority but does not remove EO 6738 own express temporal scope. No conclusion on EO 7080 whole lifecycle is assigned here.
